name: Sculpt Fist
description: Sculpt a heavy fist of qi over the hand and drive it through the guard.

name: Sculpt Stride
description: Sculpt springs of qi about the shins and take one bounding stride.

name: Sculpt Shield
description: Sculpt a broad shield of qi on the forearm and take the blow on its face.

name: Sculpt Salve
description: Sculpt a soothing film of new flesh over a wound on an ally or the user.

name: Sculpt Gauntlet
description: Sculpt a heavy gauntlet of qi on the hand so that every strike carries more weight.

name: Sculpt Lance
description: Sculpt a long lance of qi and drive it through a foe's guard.

name: Sculpt Panoply
description: Sculpt a full suit of qi armor that turns blades and softens crushing blows.

name: Sculpt Colossus
description: Sculpt a giant fist of qi above the foe and bring it down in one crushing blow.

name: Spawn Dart
description: Spawn a swarm of tiny darts that fly from the palm at one target.

name: Spawn Step
description: Spawn a servant of qi that bears the user across a short gap and fades.

name: Spawn Guard
description: Spawn a servant that throws itself into the path of a blow and is lost.

name: Spawn Warmth
description: Spawn small lights of warm qi that settle on allies and ease their limbs.

name: Spawn Swarm
description: Spawn a swarm of biting servants that scatter among the foes and strike at once.

name: Spawn Net
description: Spawn servants that join hands over a foe and drag them down in a living net.

name: Spawn Mend
description: Spawn gentle servants that carry new flesh to an ally's wounds and close them.

name: Spawn Sentinel
description: Spawn a tall sentinel that stands over a foe and holds them in place by its glare.

name: Spawn Legion
description: Spawn a legion of qi-made soldiers that charge across the field and break on the foes.

name: Wing Flail
description: Beat a wing of qi from the shoulder across the foe's guard like a heavy flail.

name: Wing Hop
description: Beat both wings once and hop clear over a low obstacle or a sweeping blade.

name: Wing Cover
description: Fold both wings forward across the body to take a blow on the feathers.

name: Wing Lift
description: Hold the wings spread so the user's leaps run longer and land lighter.

name: Wing Sweep
description: Sweep both wings round the body and knock down every foe within reach.

name: Wing Whip
description: Lash one long wing at a distant foe and snap it back as it lands.

name: Wing Arc
description: Bank on spread wings in a wide curve and come down on the foe's flank.

name: Wing Mantle
description: Wrap the user and nearby allies in great wings that turn blows and lift their steps.

name: Wright Mallet
description: Make a wright's mallet of qi and swing it down onto the foe's guard.

name: Wright Stride
description: Make a plank of qi under the lead foot and stride along it to a distant mark.

name: Wright Shield
description: Make a joined board shield of qi and set it against a charge.

name: Wright Tonic
description: Make a warm tonic of qi and press it into an ally's bruises to ease them.

name: Wright Chain
description: Make a length of heavy chain and wind it round a foe's arms and chest.

name: Wright Spear
description: Make a long spear of qi and drive it through the foe's guard.

name: Wright Snare
description: Make a hidden snare of jaws and cord that springs on the first foe to step in it.

name: Wright Revival
description: Make a spark of new breath in an ally whose breath has just stopped and restart the heart within moments.

name: Nascent Jab
description: Jab with a fist that wraps a newborn force and lets it loose on impact.

name: Nascent Step
description: Step on a newborn gust of force that lifts the foot and carries it ahead.

name: Nascent Ward
description: Bring a ward of newborn force to the front of the body in time to meet a blow.

name: Nascent Warmth
description: Give newborn warmth to an ally's limbs so they move freely in cold and weariness.

name: Nascent Chain
description: Bring newborn forces together in a chain that winds round a foe and holds.

name: Nascent Burst
description: Bring a newborn burst of force out of nothing among a cluster of foes.

name: Nascent Cleanse
description: Make clean newborn qi and wash poison or backlash from an ally's meridians.

name: Nascent Aegis
description: Raise a wall of newborn force that grows thicker where the blows fall.

name: Nascent Storm
description: Bring a storm of newborn force out of nothing and loose it across the field.

name: Fount Strike
description: Strike with a fist fed fresh from the fount so the blow lands full.

name: Fount Step
description: Draw a burst from the fount into the legs for one long and quick stride.

name: Fount Guard
description: Let the fount well up round the body in a thin bright shell that takes a blow.

name: Fount Restore
description: Pour a measure from the fount into an ally's hurt and let new flesh close the wound.

name: Fount Draught
description: Share a draught from the fount that refills an ally's strength and steadies their breath.

name: Fount Lance
description: Send a lance of fount-fed qi at a distant foe and pierce the guard.

name: Fount Revival
description: Pour the fount into a fallen ally whose breath has just stopped and drive the breath back.

name: Fount Torrent
description: Loose a torrent from the fount across the ground that hammers every foe in its course.
